sources.summary: CSCEC group news item published 24 October 2026 (发布日期), compiled from submissions by its subsidiaries, on CSCEC's data-centre and energy construction in Ulanqab. Under the heading '远景乌兰察布零碳人工智能算力产业园（一期）项目' (Envision Ulanqab Zero-Carbon AI Computing Industrial Park Phase 1) it says that in the Chahar High-Tech Development Zone the Phase 1 project built by China Construction Third Engineering Bureau (中建三局) is advancing at speed and is currently in its construction-finishing stage (目前处于施工收尾阶段). The section's project manager (a named CSCEC employee, not reproduced here) calls it Envision Energy's first data-centre project, says the works have entered the finishing stage and that the team will complete the remaining finishing and commissioning work (剩余收尾与调试工作). The item gives no capacity, completion date, operation date or customer for Phase 1. Separate sections cover Envision Phase 3 (under construction, CSCEC Harbour and Waterway Bureau), VNET A1 and A2, Huawei Phase 3 DC5 / Phase 4 DC4, UCloud building D, Kuaishou stage 2 and energy projects; none of those is used for this project.
sources.date_semantics: Published 24 October 2026. The contractor's own current report that Phase 1 is in its construction-finishing stage, read as an observation that Phase 1 is under construction on the publication date. No start day, completion, commissioning completion or operation is stated or inferred.
sources.status_statement_excerpt: 中建三局承建的远景乌兰察布零碳人工智能算力产业园（一期）项目正在加速推进，目前处于施工收尾阶段
sources.firsthand_participant: China Construction Third Engineering Bureau (中建三局), the Phase 1 builder, is a CSCEC subsidiary; the item is CSCEC's own publication.

sources.summary: EIA report form (118 pages; compiled December 2025 by an environmental consultancy for Envision (Ulanqab) Technology Development Co., Ltd., 远景（乌兰察布）科技开发有限公司) for the new 220 kV substation (2 x 160 MVA initially, 3 x 160 MVA final) built to supply Phase 1 of the Envision Ulanqab Zero-Carbon AI Computing Industrial Park. Its project code and filing number, 2501-150982-89-04-953605 (Chahar High-Tech Zone economic development and investment-promotion bureau), are the Phase 1 project's filing code. It locates the station inside the Phase 1 plant area of the park in Yiwutang Industrial Park, Chahar High-Tech Zone, on the plant's north side, with Xiaobei Village 123 m east and the Envision wind-turbine factory to the north; the station shares the Phase 1 plant's internal roads, construction camp and hazardous-waste store. Station centre printed as E113°14′54.505″, N40°56′55.632″, with four enclosure corners (0.7843 ha). It says the whole park has about 480 MW of total electrical load in two phases (Phase 1 about 160 MW, planned to enter production in 2026; Phase 2 about 320 MW, planned for 2027) and that Phase 1 works had not yet started when the report was written (目前…一期工程尚未开工). Appended figure 4 maps the substation at the north edge of the park boundary.
sources.date_semantics: Published with the approval-result publicity of 10 February 2026; report compiled December 2025, PDF created 28 January 2026. Used for the locator, park identity and planned scope. Its planned production years are forecasts and its 'not yet started' statement describes December 2025; neither is used as the status observation.
sources.coordinate_crs: Geographic degrees-minutes-seconds printed without a stated datum or accuracy; transcribed arithmetically to decimal degrees with no datum transformation. The enclosure corners are internally consistent with the centre (0.07 m) and the figure-4 graticule agrees with independent WGS84 imagery within about 10 m at two ground features; the GCJ-02 alternative contradicts the report's own map (see the geometry facts file).

sources.summary: Enterprise news item (企业动态) published by Beijing Urban Construction Group on its own website on 13 October 2026 (发布日期) about its No.2 Company (北京城建二公司), the builder of CIDC's Ulanqab zero-carbon computing cluster (中金数据乌兰察布零碳算力集群, over 1,100 mu). It says the cluster comprises the zero-carbon computing base zones A-C (574 mu, delivered and put into use in July 2025), a dedicated green-power source-grid-load-storage project about 30 km east of the base (grid-connected July 2025) and the Jing-Meng Green Computing Industrial Park D-zone (京蒙绿色算力产业园D区). It describes the D-zone as the base's extension area, 530 mu in total, forming with zones A-C a cluster of 800 MW total IT capacity; construction started in March 2025 and the D-zone project is now racing toward its completion and handover target (京蒙绿色算力产业园D区项目正全力冲刺竣工交付目标; 正朝着竣工目标全力冲刺). After the main structure, interiors and equipment are installed as prefabricated modular cabins; the project's first phase won a 2026 Beijing Great Wall Cup structural-quality award. No completion date, operation or D-zone capacity is stated.
sources.date_semantics: Published 13 October 2026. The builder's own current report that the D-zone is under construction and approaching completion, read as an observation that the D-zone is under construction on the publication date. The March 2025 start is background; no completion, handover or operation is stated or inferred. The 800 MW figure is cluster-wide planned IT capacity, not a D-zone observation.
sources.status_statement_excerpt: 京蒙绿色算力产业园D区项目正全力冲刺竣工交付目标
sources.firsthand_participant: Beijing Urban Construction Group No.2 Company (北京城建二公司), the builder of the cluster including the D-zone, is a BUCG subsidiary; the item is BUCG's own publication.
